== Strategy ==

Alright, your starting effects should be: Insurrection & Aim High, Staging Areas, and Strike Planning.

1st Turn: Use Strike Planning to grab General Calrissian and General Rieekan.Use Insurrection to grab a docking bay (usually the Hoth Docking Bay.)Use Rieekan to grab the Echo: War Room. If you have a scrub in your hand, deploy it to the Hoth Docking Bay for easy activation via Staging Areas. If you have a senator, by all means throw him down too, but you probably won't have the force to do so.

Mid-game / End-game: By now you should've flipped the Objective and began wrecking havoc on your opponents' sites. Don't be afraid to throw down your senators on your political effects. Use Noble Sacrifice on Rieekan for some easy retrival.
